facts.text: The image is a black-bordered, multi-panel dragon reference sheet: a large panoramic panel across the top, three full-body labeled views in the middle row, and four labeled detail close-ups in the bottom row.
The top panel shows a large quadrupedal dragon in a low, left-facing profile stance on dark rocky terrain, with its neck extended, wings partly raised, and long tail stretching to the right.

The dragon has charcoal-black to slate-gray armored scales, a spiky dorsal crest running from the head along the neck and back, long pale bone-colored horns, large membranous bat-like wings, clawed feet, and an orange eye visible in the close-up.
The middle row contains three full-body panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR, showing the same dragon from front, left-facing profile, and rear angles.
The bottom row contains four detail panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's face with layered scales, pale ridged horns, and a small orange eye; the mouth appears closed.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows dark, leathery wing membrane stretched between bony wing fingers, with visible folds, ridges, and faint veining.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaly lower leg and foot with several large, curved, pale claws.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with a subtle blue-teal iridescent sheen.

The top panel is set in a dark volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, mist or smoke, glowing orange lava or embers, and wet, reflective ground; the smaller reference panels use plain dark charcoal backgrounds.
Visible white uppercase labels in the panels read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

card.summary: A dark-fantasy dragon character reference sheet: a large cinematic full-body view at top, labeled front/side/rear turnarounds below, and four close-up detail studies. The dragon is charcoal-black with pale horns and claws, an orange eye, broad membranous wings, and a spiny dorsal crest.

subjects.descriptor: A large dark-armored dragon with long pale horns and broad membranous wings, shown as one identity across multiple reference views.
attributes: subtle blue-teal iridescence in the scales
spiky dorsal crest along the head, neck, back, and tail
four clawed limbs with large curved pale claws
pose: Top panel: low quadrupedal stance in left-facing profile, neck extended forward, wings lifted.
FRONT panel: facing the viewer squarely, wings spread, tail curled to one side.
SIDE PROFILE panel: left-facing standing profile, wings raised, tail extended behind.
REAR panel: seen from behind, wings spread, tail centered.
HEAD CLOSE panel: head angled slightly toward the viewer, mouth closed.

subjects.descriptor: A dark volcanic landscape surrounding the hero view, with plain dark backgrounds behind the isolated reference panels.

card.environment: Top panel: dark volcanic terrain with rocky outcrops, mist/smoke, and orange lava or ember glow. Smaller turnaround and detail panels: plain dark charcoal studio-style backgrounds.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting in the main panel, with cool rim light defining the scales and warm orange glow from lava or embers; the isolated reference panels use even, dim neutral lighting.
card.framing: Black-bordered composite reference sheet: one large panoramic hero panel on top; three full-body orthographic-style views in the middle row; four macro detail panels in the bottom row.
card.style: Dark fantasy creature concept art; photorealistic digital rendering with cinematic atmosphere and turnaround-sheet presentation.
card.characterisation: A single dragon design is documented through a cinematic hero view, three body-angle views, and four material/anatomy close-ups.

limitations: The supplied image is a static composite; it cannot establish motion, camera movement, sound, music, voice, or dialogue.
Fine texture and material details in the smaller panels are visible only at limited resolution.
No measurements, scale bars, or numerical size references appear on the sheet.
